articles.title: Pakistan women squads announced for Sri Lanka series
articles.summary: Pakistan named 15-player ODI and T20I squads for six white-ball matches in Hambantota.
body: Pakistan announced its squads for the Sri Lanka tour.
The tour contains three ODIs and three T20Is in Hambantota.

articles.title: Babar Azam returns focused on discipline, fitness and performance
articles.summary: Pakistan's Test captain says preparation and consistency will guide the team's next assignments.
body: Babar placed discipline, fitness and performance at the centre of his plans.
Pakistan will look to turn that renewed confidence into stronger Test results.

articles.title: Sports psychology added to Pakistan U19 development camp
articles.summary: The PCB introduced structured mental-skills work alongside technical and tactical training in Multan.
body: The PCB introduced a sports psychology programme at its U19 camp.
It covers concentration, confidence and decision-making under pressure.

articles.title: Pakistan confirmed as host of Women's T20 World Cup 2028
articles.summary: The ICC approved the qualification pathway for the 12-team tournament to be hosted by the PCB.
body: The ICC endorsed the qualification pathway for the 2028 tournament.
The event will feature 12 teams, including two Global Qualifier places.
